settings.text: Sadly, most brands use ingredients from Level 1 and 2. We only use ingredients from Level 5, 6 and 7. Our goal is to maximize the results for our customers. To stop acne, blemishes, red bumps and scars as fast as possible. We use the most potent ingredients on planet Earth to make sure that happens.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Organic ingredients are without the addi
settings.text: Organic ingredients are without the addition of any chemicals. They are clean and safe. But they can come from homogeneous fields. For example a field of only lavender. That makes them less potent because they don't need to defend against other species. And the soil is stripped of nutrition because it's reused again and again to grow the same thing.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The holy grail. Norwegian plants need to
settings.text: The holy grail. Norwegian plants need to survive arctic winters. They need to protect themselves from -30 degrees. The ripening window in Norway is short and the plants need to get all the nutrition to the blooms fast. Making them more potent than anything else on the planet. The Norse Organics products are filled with them.
